description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_StringHashParser, which provides methods to parse string hash configuration files, including single and multi-hash files, with support for multiline values and delimiters.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_StringHashParser
classes.description: A parser class for reading string hash configuration files, supporting single and multiple hash parsing with multiline support.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Parses a file containing a single string hash and returns an associative array.

methods.name: parseMultiFile
methods.description: Parses a file containing multiple string hashes delimited by '----' and returns an array of associative arrays.

methods.name: parseHandle
methods.description: Internal method that reads from a file handle and parses a string hash block, supporting comments, multiline declarations, and default keys.
